full_judgment: 6. Leave has been granted to consider the submissions that the judgment of the High Court Division was not a proper judgment of  reversal and the High Court Division was wrong in holding that there was no presumption of correctness of RS Khatian under the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act and the observations in that behalf on the basis of which only the suit was decreed, were not at all correct and justified, that there having no consideration of the plaintiffs' case and the finding made by the trial Court against the plaintiffs, the decree passed in their favour is not legal and sustainable in law.
